answer: An onyx-black ledger records every job, and a ferrous thread ties each agent to its clients. Each epoch the registry maps this work graph: 1) every finished job records client and counterparty on-ledger; 2) agents whose client sets overlap over 80% are flagged as one cluster; 3) flagged agents must pass a live supervised task within an hour or freeze; 4) a confirmed clone loses its bond and its cluster is blacklisted. A 1,000-clone farm must buy 1,000 client relationships at about $30 each, $30,000, while one honest agent's meadow of real clients grows wild, like grass no fence can fake.
